title: The Chat inspector is re-registered on every controller render, so it renders twice while open
reason: Render count only (the inspector registers twice); no operator-visible symptom was measured.

title: Opening any non-Chat page still loads the whole Chat module graph
reason: Bundle structure (non-Chat pages load the Chat module graph); the production build opens every area in under 1 s (Task 13b), so no operator-visible cost was shown.

title: Raw buttons and literal radii still sit beside the shared Button and radius tokens
reason: Developer hygiene (raw buttons and literal radii beside the shared primitives); no operator-visible symptom of its own (ledger b4, GL-42).

title: The Cockpit still overrides 67 Classic/shared class names with selectors of different strength
reason: Developer hygiene (67 Classic/shared class names restyled with mixed selector strength); the register row itself says not operator-visible (ledger b4, GL-43).

title: The bundle budget check measures the entry stub, not the Cockpit that loads first
reason: Build tooling: the bundle budget check measures the entry stub, not the Cockpit (ledger b4, GL-48).

title: Tailwind still scans the whole app folder (Classic, tests, mockups)
reason: Build tooling: Tailwind scans the whole app folder; no styling is missing, the cost is build work (ledger b4, GL-50).

title: On a phone, the More tab does not look selected while you are in Capabilities, System or Settings
reason: Not reproduced: the More tab carries aria-current=page and a teal underline in Capabilities, System and Settings in both themes (gl-7-system-375-light.png and the finding's own NV-18.png show the underline).

title: Safety > Tools lists dozens of identical-looking 'Allow - Session' grants with only 'Inspect grant' and 'Revoke grant' to tell them apart
reason: The 171 near-identical grants were most likely seeded by earlier test tasks in the shared sandbox; not shown to occur on a real install (Task 11 review).

title: Each owner link in Work and Inbox lists mounts its own navigation handoff owner
reason: Code structure only (one navigation handoff owner per link); impact on speed was never measured and no operator symptom is described.
